setting: After a long workweek, a couple spends a quiet Friday night together at home.
lyrics:
It's Friday night, dim lights and a quiet storm
I'm waiting patiently playing our favorite song
We've been working all week and now we got a night alone
So baby won't you hurry up
cuz I've been waiting all day long

Baby cuz tonight, Imma blow ya mind, going 'til the crack of dawn
Better come prepared, you can't go nowhere, Cuz I'm gonna lock the door
We can go slow and take our time
Baby Imma make you lose your mind
Getcha good and hot, you won't wanna stop, Keep it going all night long

Girl bring your body here, lay down right next to me
Just close your eyes while I explore your fantasy
Don't fight this feeling baby, cuz I I'm ready and willing
To take you to a place that I know you ain't prepared for
(Keep) goin' 'til you beg me for more

lyricConnections.explanationJa: 「二人きりの夜」。have a night alone で、二人だけで過ごせる夜を表す。
「急がず時間をかける」。食事や準備など日常の場面にも使える。
「私たちのお気に入りの曲」。共通の好みを話すときにも使える。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: We finally have a night alone after working all week.

conversation.japanese: 一週間ずっと働いて、やっと二人きりの夜だね。出かける？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I've been looking forward to a quiet evening with you.

conversation.japanese: 正直、家で過ごしたいな。あなたと静かな夜を過ごすのを楽しみにしてたの。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: We can take our time and cook dinner together.

conversation.japanese: いいね。ゆっくり一緒に夕食を作ろう。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Put on our favorite song while I get things ready.

conversation.japanese: いいね。準備する間、私たちのお気に入りの曲をかけて。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: No need to hurry; we have all night.

conversation.japanese: 明かりを少し落とすよ。急がなくていい、夜はまだ長いから。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Then come sit next to me for a minute.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、少し私の隣に座って。
